info.name: Financial Modeling Prep Analyst Estimates API

params.name: symbol
params.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL. Some endpoints accept forex (EURUSD) or crypto (BTCUSD) symbols.

params.description: Zero-based page number for paginated results.

items.docs: Returns consensus analyst estimates - projected revenue, EPS, EBITDA, and net income - for a ticker symbol, by annual or quarterly period.
